user.title: Add feeder
user.description: Recommended: reuse the Tuya account already authorized in Home Assistant. Or sign in by scanning a QR code.

account.title: Pick a device
account.description: Reads devices from the Tuya authorization already stored in Home Assistant. If this fails, use QR or manual setup.

qr.title: Enter your User Code
qr.description: Find it in the Londa app: Me → gear icon → **Account and Security** → **User Code** at the bottom. Copy it exactly (case sensitive).

qr_scan.title: Scan with the Londa app
qr_scan.description: Scan this QR code with the Londa app (the + button → Scan) and confirm on your phone. Then click **Submit** here.

qr_pick.title: Pick a device
qr_pick.description: Choose the feeder to add. Its LAN address is resolved automatically next.

manual.title: Enter connection details
manual.description:
Enter the feeder's LAN address and localKey.
Keep protocol on "auto" — it tries 3.5 → 3.4 → 3.3 → 3.1 in order.

dp_map.title: Map data points

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. Make sure it is on the same LAN.
error.no_dps: Device responded but reported no data points.
error.invalid_user_code: Wrong User Code ({msg} / {code}). Copy it again from the app.
error.qr_not_scanned: No authorization yet ({msg}). Scan with the app and confirm, then submit.
error.cloud_error: Authorized, but fetching the device list failed. Check the logs.
error.no_devices: No devices in this account. Add the feeder in the app first.
error.no_tuya_entry: No Tuya authorization found in Home Assistant. Add the official Tuya integration first, or use QR / manual setup.
error.device_not_found: Device not found on the LAN. Check it is on the same subnet and 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.
